question: Can the manager eliminate copy launch delays, can GPU capture be disabled, how portable is MiniCPM-o 4.5, and what protocol should measure session capacity?

configuration_profile.type: Source and external primary-document audit; no serving experiment
configuration_profile.runtime: Installed locked vLLM environment; current two first-party workers

change: Add candidate protocols, readiness gates and model adaptation boundaries to docs/experiments.md. No runtime, model/environment lock, trace artifact or accepted performance finding changed.

result.copy_control: SessionManager.advance calls adapter.restore; CopyService already owns persistent H2D/D2H streams and submits independently of model steps. Moving backend.launch to the manager thread would not remove its native-call cost. Submission optimization and pipeline/contending-load calibration are proposed, not implemented.
result.profiler_check_method: Construct ConveyorConfig(session_manager=True, retained_prefix_blocks=128, duration_s=30) for each flag pair, validate, inspect worker_environment and required_artifact_names. No directories or GPU work created.
result.model_readiness: Installed MiniCPMO4_5 supports the Qwen3-based audio-input model path and load_weights skips tts. Current project still binds model ID/revision/geometry, Qwen prompt tokens and audio wrapper. vLLM-Omni was not installed. Upstream MiniCPM-o model card and vLLM-Omni native duplex docs were inspected; no claim that our KV adapter runs on that stack.
result.dataset_review: Primary sources describe CANDOR and Fisher two-person tracks and MagicData speaker-separated recordings. No corpus downloaded or empirical lifetime distribution fitted. MagicData download-page license and Chinese sample-size discrepancy are retained as access/metadata limits, not silently resolved using the paper.

remaining_uncertainty: All SLO thresholds, synthetic lifetime parameters and sample sizes in the experiment owner are proposed values, not frozen user decisions or measured findings.
No MiniCPM-o weights, native duplex multi-session run, model-output equivalence or KV integration was tested.
Existing client and frame/output instrumentation do not establish per-cycle model completion or dynamic admission; the planned benchmark is not implemented.
The earlier copy audit localizes overhead to host submission but does not separately time CUDA batch API internals and host scheduling.
